test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e751cf1bfedce203ac4195c89b695a583e68ed4f414f13ce0813b2d8f45df4f8.png]
solution:
The figure given below is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/901b739c50138cdee5f8b1669e5428340f435c43aacd0d0d97774746693c88b5.png] 

From figure 2 and 3, we understand that 5 and 4 is not the opposite face of 1 and 2.

The opposite faces are 1 - 2

Hence, the correct answer is **"2".**
